text: 沪指低开回升涨0.16%，培育钻石、医药股集体走强。 港股探底回升，恒指半日涨0.35%，恒生科技指数涨0.17%，恒生生物科技指数大涨逾3%。 AI开发放缓叠加油价飙升，日韩股市下跌，韩国首尔综指跌超2%。 上期所原油期货主力合约日内涨超11%，站上900元/桶，为上市以来首次。 中国央行公开市场开展5040亿元隔夜逆回购操作。 中证协：加大对投行、债券交易等重点业务关键环节的内部检查力度；禁止利用算法设计等方式输送或谋取不正当利益。 国家卫健委：进一步营造生育友好环境。
text_en: The Shanghai Composite Index opened lower and rebounded to gain 0.16%, with lab-grown diamond and pharmaceutical stocks strengthening collectively. Hong Kong stocks bottomed out and rebounded, with the Hang Seng Index up 0.35% at midday, the Hang Seng Tech Index up 0.17%, and the Hang Seng Biotech Index surging more than 3%. As AI development slowed and oil prices soared, Japanese and South Korean stock markets fell, with South Korea's KOSPI dropping more than 2%. The front-month crude oil futures contract on the Shanghai Futures Exchange rose more than 11% intraday, surpassing 900 yuan per barrel for the first time since listing. China's central bank conducted 504 billion yuan of overnight reverse repurchase operations in the open market. Securities Association of China: Step up internal inspections of key links in key businesses such as investment banking and bond trading; prohibit the use of algorithm design and other methods to convey or seek improper benefits. National Health Commission: Further foster a fertility-friendly environment.
